subjects.title: The Machine Tunnel client type in ZPA policy
subjects.lead: Machine Tunnel is one of the client types an access policy rule can select, beside Zscaler Client Connector, Client Connector for VDI, Client Connector Partn...

subjects.title: Machine tunnel status and removal in Client Connector
subjects.lead: A machine tunnel's status is Active, Inactive, Removed or Unregistered.

subjects.title: Device posture on the ZPA machine tunnel
subjects.lead: A device posture profile has Apply to Windows Machine Tunnel and Apply to macOS Machine Tunnel settings.

subjects.title: Machine provisioning keys for ZPA machine tunnels
subjects.lead: A machine provisioning key is a text string generated when the key is added in the Admin Console.

subjects.title: What a ZPA machine tunnel needs before it can connect
subjects.lead: A machine tunnel lets a Windows or macOS device establish a connection to a service before the user is logged in to Zscaler Client Connector.
